name: The High Elder's Request

angles.text: For priests studying divine or ritual manipulation, the cult's interest in anchor pylons and the skypriest's involvement at the western watchtower are troubling signs.

faq.answer: High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong is a leader in Valanaar. Coordinated cult activity has struck the region's watchtowers, and he seeks capable allies to pursue leads on the cult's intentions.
Valanaar is where High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong is stationed. He coordinates defenses and investigates cult incursions against local anchor pylons and towers.
Coordinated attacks struck both the western and eastern watchtowers. Defenders suspect deliberate maneuvers aimed at the nearby anchor pylons, not random raids.
Anchor pylons are important defensive or regional structures. Reports from the western watchtower suggest a hostile cult means to interfere with them or subvert them.
A skypriest was involved in the incident at the western watchtower. Reports from that encounter led leaders to suspect the cult has a broader scheme involving the anchor pylons.
faq.q: Who was the skypriest at the western watchtower?

faq.answer: A hostile cult carried out simultaneous strikes on the region's watchtowers. Its nature and motives remain under investigation as High Elder Shadowsong works to uncover its plans.
faq.q: What cult is targeting the watchtowers?

sections.body: Coordinated assaults on the western and eastern watchtowers reveal a troubling pattern. What seemed like scattered skirmishes now points to a planned attack on the local anchor pylons. A report from the western watchtower tells how a skypriest revealed the cult's interest in these structures. Now the towers' defense is an urgent concern.
sections.title: Trouble at the Watchtowers

sections.body: The threat to the anchor pylons is growing, so leaders send you to speak with High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. He has a promising lead on the cult's movements and seeks experienced allies to track the enemy. The cult may be preparing a ritual or sabotage.
sections.title: Audience in Valanaar

summary: In Valanaar, High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong calls for help after coordinated assaults strike the region's watchtowers. Reports from the western watchtower point to a hostile cult targeting the local anchor pylons.
